findings.location: Study proof physical page 10; sections/20-texts.tex ending and sections/30-allegiance.tex opening clearpage
findings.problem: The final two appointed-text locator units occupy only the upper portion of page 10 before the forced start of the first interpretation, producing a conspicuously sparse intermediate page. This is layout polish and does not impair depth, accuracy or usability.
findings.required_result: At a convenient layout pass, reflow the locator section or its following page break to reduce the sparse spill while preserving readable type and a clear beginning for the first interpretation.

findings.accepted_because: The complete entries remain clearly headed and easy to retrieve, and the fresh-page interpretation boundary aids navigation. The study contains substantial exposition and its 23-page extent does not rely on this sparse page to reach the 20-page minimum. Reflow would disturb settled pagination for a cosmetic saving without correcting misleading or inaccessible content.
